translations.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
translations.ylt: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
translations.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

translations.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ!
translations.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
translations.ylt: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who did bless us in every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
translations.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

translations.kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
translations.ylt: according as He did choose us in him before the foundation of the world, for our being holy and unblemished before Him, in love,
translations.web: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

translations.kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
translations.ylt: having foreordained us to the adoption of sons through Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,
translations.web: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

translations.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
translations.ylt: to the praise of the glory of His grace, in which He did make us accepted in the beloved,
translations.web: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

translations.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
translations.ylt: in whom we have the redemption through his blood, the remission of the trespasses, according to the riches of His grace,
translations.web: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

translations.kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
translations.ylt: in which He did abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
translations.web: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

translations.kjv: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
translations.ylt: having made known to us the secret of His will, according to His good pleasure, that He purposed in Himself,
translations.web: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

translations.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
translations.ylt: in regard to the dispensation of the fulness of the times, to bring into one the whole in the Christ, both the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth--in him;
translations.web: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

translations.kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
translations.ylt: in whom also we did obtain an inheritance, being foreordained according to the purpose of Him who the all things is working according to the counsel of His will,
translations.web: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

translations.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
translations.ylt: for our being to the praise of His glory, even those who did first hope in the Christ,
translations.web: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

translations.kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
translations.ylt: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth--the good news of your salvation--in whom also having believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of the promise,
translations.web: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

translations.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
translations.ylt: which is an earnest of our inheritance, to the redemption of the acquired possession, to the praise of His glory.
translations.web: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
translations.ylt: Because of this I also, having heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and the love to all the saints,
translations.web: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

translations.kjv: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
translations.ylt: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
translations.web: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

translations.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
translations.ylt: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of the glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the recognition of him,
translations.web: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

translations.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
translations.ylt: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened, for your knowing what is the hope of His calling, and what the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,
translations.web: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

translations.kjv: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
translations.ylt: and what the exceeding greatness of His power to us who are believing, according to the working of the power of His might,
translations.web: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

translations.kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
translations.ylt: which He wrought in the Christ, having raised him out of the dead, and did set him at His right hand in the heavenly places,
translations.web: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

translations.kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
translations.ylt: far above all principality, and authority, and might, and lordship, and every name named, not only in this age, but also in the coming one;
translations.web: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

translations.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
translations.ylt: and all things He did put under his feet, and did give him--head over all things to the assembly,
translations.web: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

translations.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
translations.ylt: which is his body, the fulness of Him who is filling the all in all,
translations.web: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

translations.kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
translations.ylt: Also you--being dead in the trespasses and the sins,
translations.web: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

translations.kjv: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
translations.ylt: in which once ye did walk according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit that is now working in the sons of disobedience,
translations.web: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

translations.kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
translations.ylt: among whom also we all did walk once in the desires of our flesh, doing the wishes of the flesh and of the thoughts, and were by nature children of wrath--as also the others,
translations.web: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

translations.kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
translations.ylt: and God, being rich in kindness, because of His great love with which He loved us,
translations.web: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

translations.kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
translations.ylt: even being dead in the trespasses, did make us to live together with the Christ, (by grace ye are having been saved,)
translations.web: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

translations.kjv: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
translations.ylt: and did raise us up together, and did seat us together in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: that He might show, in the ages that are coming, the exceeding riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

translations.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
translations.ylt: for by grace ye are having been saved, through faith, and this not of you--of God the gift,
translations.web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

translations.kjv: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
translations.ylt: not of works, that no one may boast;
translations.web: not of works, that no one would boast.

translations.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
translations.ylt: for of Him we are workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God did before prepare, that in them we may walk.
translations.web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

translations.kjv: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
translations.ylt: Wherefore, remember, that ye were once the nations in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that called Circumcision in the flesh made by hands,
translations.web: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

translations.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
translations.ylt: that ye were at that time apart from Christ, having been alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, having no hope, and without God, in the world;
translations.web: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

translations.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
translations.ylt: and now, in Christ Jesus, ye being once afar off became nigh in the blood of the Christ,
translations.web: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

translations.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
translations.ylt: for he is our peace, who did make both one, and the middle wall of the enclosure did break down,
translations.web: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

translations.kjv: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
translations.ylt: the enmity in his flesh, the law of the commands in ordinances having done away, that the two he might create in himself into one new man, making peace,
translations.web: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

translations.kjv: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
translations.ylt: and might reconcile both in one body to God through the cross, having slain the enmity in it,
translations.web: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

translations.kjv: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
translations.ylt: and having come, he did proclaim good news--peace to you--the far-off and the nigh,
translations.web: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

translations.kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
translations.ylt: because through him we have the access--we both--in one Spirit unto the Father.
translations.web: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

translations.kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
translations.ylt: Then, therefore, ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow-citizens of the saints, and of the household of God,
translations.web: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

translations.kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
translations.ylt: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being chief corner- stone,
translations.web: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

translations.kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
translations.ylt: in whom all the building fitly framed together doth increase to an holy sanctuary in the Lord,
translations.web: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

translations.kjv: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
translations.ylt: in whom also ye are builded together, for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
translations.web: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

translations.kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
translations.ylt: For this cause, I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you the nations,
translations.web: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

translations.kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
translations.ylt: if, indeed, ye did hear of the dispensation of the grace of God that was given to me in regard to you,
translations.web: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

translations.kjv: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
translations.ylt: that by revelation He made known to me the secret, according as I wrote before in few words --
translations.web: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

translations.kjv: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
translations.ylt: in regard to which ye are able, reading it, to understand my knowledge in the secret of the Christ,
translations.web: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

translations.kjv: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
translations.ylt: which in other generations was not made known to the sons of men, as it was now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit--
translations.web: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

translations.kjv: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
translations.ylt: that the nations be fellow-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of His promise in the Christ, through the good news,
translations.web: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

translations.kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
translations.ylt: of which I became a ministrant, according to the gift of the grace of God that was given to me, according to the working of His power;
translations.web: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

translations.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
translations.ylt: to me--the less than the least of all the saints--was given this grace, among the nations to proclaim good news--the untraceable riches of the Christ,
translations.web: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

translations.kjv: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: and to cause all to see what is the fellowship of the secret that hath been hid from the ages in God, who the all things did create by Jesus Christ,
translations.web: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
translations.ylt: that there might be made known now to the principalities and the authorities in the heavenly places, through the assembly, the manifold wisdom of God,
translations.web: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

translations.kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
translations.ylt: according to a purpose of the ages, which He made in Christ Jesus our Lord,
translations.web: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

translations.kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
translations.ylt: in whom we have the freedom and the access in confidence through the faith of him,
translations.web: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
translations.ylt: wherefore, I ask you not to faint in my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
translations.web: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

translations.kjv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translations.ylt: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translations.web: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
translations.ylt: of whom the whole family in the heavens and on earth is named,
translations.web: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

translations.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
translations.ylt: that He may give to you, according to the riches of His glory, with might to be strengthened through His Spirit, in regard to the inner man,
translations.web: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

translations.kjv: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
translations.ylt: that the Christ may dwell through the faith in your hearts, in love having been rooted and founded,
translations.web: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

translations.kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
translations.ylt: that ye may be in strength to comprehend, with all the saints, what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height,
translations.web: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

translations.kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
translations.ylt: to know also the love of the Christ that is exceeding the knowledge, that ye may be filled--to all the fulness of God;
translations.web: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

translations.kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
translations.ylt: and to Him who is able above all things to do exceeding abundantly what we ask or think, according to the power that is working in us,
translations.web: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

translations.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
translations.ylt: to Him is the glory in the assembly in Christ Jesus, to all the generations of the age of the ages. Amen.
translations.web: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
translations.ylt: Call upon you, then, do I--the prisoner of the Lord--to walk worthily of the calling with which ye were called,
translations.web: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

translations.kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
translations.ylt: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love,
translations.web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

translations.kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
translations.ylt: being diligent to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of the peace;
translations.web: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

translations.kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
translations.ylt: one body and one Spirit, according as also ye were called in one hope of your calling;
translations.web: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

translations.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
translations.ylt: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
translations.web: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

translations.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
translations.ylt: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in you all,
translations.web: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

translations.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
translations.ylt: and to each one of you was given the grace, according to the measure of the gift of Christ,
translations.web: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

translations.kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
translations.ylt: wherefore, he saith, `Having gone up on high he led captive captivity, and gave gifts to men,' --
translations.web: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

translations.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
translations.ylt: and that, he went up, what is it except that he also went down first to the lower parts of the earth?
translations.web: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

translations.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
translations.ylt: he who went down is the same also who went up far above all the heavens, that He may fill all things--
translations.web: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

translations.kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
translations.ylt: and He gave some as apostles, and some as prophets, and some as proclaimers of good news, and some as shepherds and teachers,
translations.web: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

translations.kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
translations.ylt: unto the perfecting of the saints, for a work of ministration, for a building up of the body of the Christ,
translations.web: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

translations.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
translations.ylt: till we may all come to the unity of the faith and of the recognition of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to a measure of stature of the fulness of the Christ,
translations.web: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

translations.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
translations.ylt: that we may no more be babes, tossed and borne about by every wind of the teaching, in the sleight of men, in craftiness, unto the artifice of leading astray,
translations.web: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

translations.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
translations.ylt: and, being true in love, we may increase to Him in all things, who is the head--the Christ;
translations.web: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

translations.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
translations.ylt: from whom the whole body, being fitly joined together and united, through the supply of every joint, according to the working in the measure of each single part, the increase of the body doth make for the building up of itself in love.
translations.web: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

translations.kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
translations.ylt: This, then, I say, and I testify in the Lord; ye are no more to walk, as also the other nations walk, in the vanity of their mind,
translations.web: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

translations.kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
translations.ylt: being darkened in the understanding, being alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart,
translations.web: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

translations.kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
translations.ylt: who, having ceased to feel, themselves did give up to the lasciviousness, for the working of all uncleanness in greediness;
translations.web: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

translations.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;
translations.ylt: and ye did not so learn the Christ,
translations.web: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

translations.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
translations.ylt: if so be ye did hear him, and in him were taught, as truth is in Jesus;
translations.web: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

translations.kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
translations.ylt: ye are to put off concerning the former behaviour the old man, that is corrupt according to the desires of the deceit,
translations.web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

translations.kjv: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
translations.ylt: and to be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
translations.web: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

translations.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
translations.ylt: and to put on the new man, which, according to God, was created in righteousness and kindness of the truth.
translations.web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

translations.kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
translations.ylt: Wherefore, putting away the lying, speak truth each with his neighbour, because we are members one of another;
translations.web: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

translations.kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
translations.ylt: be angry and do not sin; let not the sun go down upon your wrath,
translations.web: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

translations.kjv: Neither give place to the devil.
translations.ylt: neither give place to the devil;
translations.web: and don’t give place to the devil.

translations.kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
translations.ylt: whoso is stealing let him no more steal, but rather let him labour, working the thing that is good with the hands, that he may have to impart to him having need.
translations.web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

translations.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
translations.ylt: Let no corrupt word out of your mouth go forth, but what is good unto the needful building up, that it may give grace to the hearers;
translations.web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

translations.kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
translations.ylt: and make not sorrowful the Holy Spirit of God, in which ye were sealed to a day of redemption.
translations.web: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

translations.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
translations.ylt: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil-speaking, be put away from you, with all malice,
translations.web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

translations.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
translations.ylt: and become one to another kind, tender-hearted, forgiving one another, according as also God in Christ did forgive you.
translations.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

translations.kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
translations.ylt: Become, then, followers of God, as children beloved,
translations.web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

translations.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
translations.ylt: and walk in love, as also the Christ did love us, and did give himself for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odour of a sweet smell,
translations.web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

translations.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
translations.ylt: and whoredom, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;
translations.web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

translations.kjv: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
translations.ylt: also filthiness, and foolish talking, or jesting, --the things not fit--but rather thanksgiving;
translations.web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

translations.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
translations.ylt: for this ye know, that every whoremonger, or unclean, or covetous person, who is an idolater, hath no inheritance in the reign of the Christ and God.
translations.web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

translations.kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
translations.ylt: Let no one deceive you with vain words, for because of these things cometh the anger of God upon the sons of the disobedience,
translations.web: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

translations.kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
translations.ylt: become not, then, partakers with them,
translations.web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

translations.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
translations.ylt: for ye were once darkness, and now light in the Lord; as children of light walk ye,
translations.web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

translations.kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
translations.ylt: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, and righteousness, and truth,
translations.web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

translations.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
translations.ylt: proving what is well-pleasing to the Lord,
translations.web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

translations.kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
translations.ylt: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of the darkness and rather even convict,
translations.web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

translations.kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
translations.ylt: for the things in secret done by them it is a shame even to speak of,
translations.web: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

translations.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
translations.ylt: and all the things reproved by the light are manifested, for everything that is manifested is light;
translations.web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

translations.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
translations.ylt: wherefore he saith, `Arouse thyself, thou who art sleeping, and arise out of the dead, and the Christ shall shine upon thee.'
translations.web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

translations.kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
translations.ylt: See, then, how exactly ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
translations.web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

translations.kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
translations.ylt: redeeming the time, because the days are evil;
translations.web: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

translations.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
translations.ylt: because of this become not fools, but--understanding what is the will of the Lord,
translations.web: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

translations.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
translations.ylt: and be not drunk with wine, in which is dissoluteness, but be filled in the Spirit,
translations.web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

translations.kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
translations.ylt: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,
translations.web: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

translations.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
translations.ylt: giving thanks always for all things, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to the God and Father;
translations.web: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

translations.kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
translations.ylt: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of God.
translations.web: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

translations.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
translations.ylt: The wives! to your own husbands subject yourselves, as to the Lord,
translations.web: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

translations.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
translations.ylt: because the husband is head of the wife, as also the Christ is head of the assembly, and he is saviour of the body,
translations.web: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

translations.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
translations.ylt: but even as the assembly is subject to Christ, so also are the wives to their own husbands in everything.
translations.web: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

translations.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
translations.ylt: The husbands! love your own wives, as also the Christ did love the assembly, and did give himself for it,
translations.web: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

translations.kjv: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
translations.ylt: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it with the bathing of the water in the saying,
translations.web: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

translations.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
translations.ylt: that he might present it to himself the assembly in glory, not having spot or wrinkle, or any of such things, but that it may be holy and unblemished;
translations.web: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

translations.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
translations.ylt: so ought the husbands to love their own wives as their own bodies: he who is loving his own wife--himself he doth love;
translations.web: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

translations.kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
translations.ylt: for no one ever his own flesh did hate, but doth nourish and cherish it, as also the Lord--the assembly,
translations.web: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

translations.kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
translations.ylt: because members we are of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones;
translations.web: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

translations.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
translations.ylt: `for this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they shall be--the two--for one flesh;'
translations.web: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

translations.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
translations.ylt: this secret is great, and I speak in regard to Christ and to the assembly;
translations.web: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
translations.ylt: but ye also, every one in particular--let each his own wife so love as himself, and the wife--that she may reverence the husband.
translations.web: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

translations.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
translations.ylt: The children! obey your parents in the Lord, for this is righteous;
translations.web: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

translations.kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
translations.ylt: honour thy father and mother,
translations.web: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

translations.kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
translations.ylt: which is the first command with a promise, `That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live a long time upon the land.'
translations.web: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

translations.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
translations.ylt: And the fathers! provoke not your children, but nourish them in the instruction and admonition of the Lord.
translations.web: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

translations.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
translations.ylt: The servants! obey the masters according to the flesh with fear and trembling, in the simplicity of your heart, as to the Christ;
translations.web: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

translations.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
translations.ylt: not with eye-service as men-pleasers, but as servants of the Christ, doing the will of God out of soul,
translations.web: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

translations.kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
translations.ylt: with good-will serving, as to the Lord, and not to men,
translations.web: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

translations.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
translations.ylt: having known that whatever good thing each one may do, this he shall receive from the Lord, whether servant or freeman.
translations.web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

translations.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
translations.ylt: And the masters! the same things do ye unto them, letting threatening alone, having known that also your Master is in the heavens, and acceptance of persons is not with him.
translations.web: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

translations.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
translations.ylt: As to the rest, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might;
translations.web: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

translations.kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
translations.ylt: put on the whole armour of God, for your being able to stand against the wiles of the devil,
translations.web: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

translations.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
translations.ylt: because we have not the wrestling with blood and flesh, but with the principalities, with the authorities, with the world-rulers of the darkness of this age, with the spiritual things of the evil in the heavenly places;
translations.web: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

translations.kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
translations.ylt: because of this take ye up the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to resist in the day of the evil, and all things having done--to stand.
translations.web: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

translations.kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
translations.ylt: Stand, therefore, having your loins girt about in truth, and having put on the breastplate of the righteousness,
translations.web: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

translations.kjv: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
translations.ylt: and having the feet shod in the preparation of the good-news of the peace;
translations.web: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

translations.kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
translations.ylt: above all, having taken up the shield of the faith, in which ye shall be able all the fiery darts of the evil one to quench,
translations.web: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

translations.kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
translations.ylt: and the helmet of the salvation receive, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the saying of God,
translations.web: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

translations.kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
translations.ylt: through all prayer and supplication praying at all times in the Spirit, and in regard to this same, watching in all perseverance and supplication for all the saints--
translations.web: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

translations.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
translations.ylt: and in behalf of me, that to me may be given a word in the opening of my mouth, in freedom, to make known the secret of the good news,
translations.web: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

translations.kjv: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
translations.ylt: for which I am an ambassador in a chain, that in it I may speak freely--as it behoveth me to speak.
translations.web: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

translations.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
translations.ylt: And that ye may know--ye also--the things concerning me--what I do, all things make known to you shall Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful ministrant in the Lord,
translations.web: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

translations.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
translations.ylt: whom I did send unto you for this very thing, that ye might know the things concerning us, and that he might comfort your hearts.
translations.web: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

translations.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: Peace to the brethren, and love, with faith, from God the Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ!
translations.web: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
translations.ylt: The grace with all those loving our Lord Jesus Christ--undecayingly! Amen.
translations.web: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
